groups.groupName: Tier 1 - Baked Goods & Pastries (Moderate Nutrient Density)
groups.comparisonSentence: Unlike confectionery chocolate bars which are dominated by refined sugars and saturated fats, these baked goods provide more sustained carbohydrate energy and dietary satisfaction.
groups.message: Bakery items such as Polo bread and cheese buns offer larger food volume and greater satiating value per calorie than pure chocolate confectionery. However, they remain processed baked goods containing refined flour, added sugars, and fats. Consume in moderation as part of a balanced diet, particularly monitoring total carbohydrate and caloric intake.

groups.groupName: Tier 2 - Confectionery Chocolate Bar (High Sugar & Saturated Fat)
groups.comparisonSentence: Compared to larger bakery items, this confectionery bar delivers a concentrated surge of refined sugar and saturated fat in a small portion, posing higher glycemic and metabolic loads relative to its volume.
groups.message: SilverQueen Milk Chocolate with Cashews delivers 110 kcal, 7g total fat (3.5g saturated fat), and 6g of sugar per modest 20g serving. Frequent consumption contributes significant added sugars and saturated fats that can negatively impact lipid profiles and metabolic health. Cashews provide minimal protein (2g), but cannot offset the high glycemic and caloric density.
groups.orderingTip: Limit consumption to a single serving (20g portion) rather than consuming the entire bar at once, and avoid pairing with other sugary snacks to protect metabolic health.
